item.title: [GRATUIT] Cults3d > TheJumpDaddy > Regina_Monstrum [non dl]
item.description:
Source : https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/regina-monstrum

Id objet : regina-monstrum

Prix : 0.0 euros

Collections :

  • epic superlourds TYRANIDES Tyranides-dominatrix

Collections pour tags :

  • epic superlourds TYRANIDES Tyranides-dominatrix NONDL NONSUP

Description :

1

Unlike the Hive Tyrant, which functions as a battlefield general, the Regina Monstrum is a living extension of the Hive Mind’s cold, starving ego. Where it treads, the ground does not merely shake; it curdles, responding to the overwhelming psychic pressure radiating from the creature’s pulsating, semi-exposed brain-vault. It is a biological paradox—a siege engine of impossible mass that moves with the sickening grace of a predatory insect. Its primary dorsal cannon is not a weapon in the traditional sense, but a specialized birthing canal for hyper-accelerated, corrosive spores that dissolve ferro-crete and bone alike in a matter of seconds. To look upon the Regina Monstrum is to see the inevitable end of the evolutionary ladder: a queen that does not rule through loyalty or fear, but through a synaptic tether so absolute that every creature in its shadow becomes merely a finger on its many-clawed hand. When a world falls, it is often the last thing the survivors see—a towering, chitinous monument to the fact that the universe does not care for their gods, only for their biomass.

My next contribution to Wolk's big collab - United Mecha Creators Project. Here's my collection of 6x6 General Service Trucks for your BattleTech games. They can easily represent the base variant of the 10 Ton [Flatbed Truck](https://www.sarna.net/wiki/Flatbed_Truck). Great for convoy escort missions or just as scatter terrain!

There is 6 different 6x6 trucks:
- Cargo Truck with dropsides
- Cargo Truck with canopy
- Flatbed Cargo Truck
- Tanker Truck
- Container Truck
- Container Truck - unladen
Ther'es also a shipping container and 2 pallets of cargo for them to transport. 

These are scaled for BattleTech (approx 6mm), but they can easily be scaled up for other table top games, since they're not very Sci-Fi looking.

Go check out the other creators in this project:
- **[Wolk-STL-Works](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Wolk-STL-Works/3d-models)
- [Crow Industries](https://www.patreon.com/CrowIndustries)
- [Default Entry](https://cults3d.com/en/users/default_entry/3d-models)
- [Ellie_Valkyrie](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Ellie_Valkyrie/3d-models)
- [Fox_Fi](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Fox-Fi/3d-models)
- [Iron_Menagerie](https://boosty.to/ironmenagerie)
- [KarlStreiger](https://cults3d.com/en/users/KarlStreiger/3d-models)
- [Unrested Guy](https://www.thingiverse.com/UnrestedGuy/designs)**

There's going to be a series of releases of models as part of this project, so keep checking in on all of the creators pages!

This is the Basic Raptor, a free demonstration build of mine in 28mm/1-56th scale that I have shrunk to a quarter of its regular size for games of New Epic, AT-18, and other similar games.

These are tiny pieces. Some weapon barrels are as thin as support structures. Turn back. Down this road, madness awaits.

Take great care in post-processing. Print multiples, in case you snap something. Use heat to loosen supports before you try and free the objects. Use a soft toothbrush and light strokes when cleaning.

Otherwise, these take about 14 or 15 grams of material. You can make a few mistakes, since a kilogram bottle of resin contains potentially 66 or more Tiny Terrors.

Join my Discord to show off your little guys.
 https://discord.gg/7PyEqpkARb

Of join my Patreon at www.patreon.com/johnbearross to get discounts on my paid files, and support my caffeine habit.

Enjoy!

Best,
John Bear Ross

This stalwart and sturdy Corgi is here to join you on your adventures!

These models are designed for use with tabletop roleplaying games, such as Dungeons and Dragons or Pathfinder, but it is detailed enough to scale up and print as you please.

As is, it is scaled to fit on a 25.4mm / 1 inch round base, not included. The 3-Headed version is scaled for both Medium and Large bases, so print him as large and terrifying as you want!

Two versions of the four standard Corgis are provided: Heroic, and Small. Small is scaled to be close to 28mm accurate, and Heroic is scaled to be larger and easier to print. If you have any doubts as to which to choose, go for Heroic!

This model was made possible thanks to the support of https://beldolorstudios.com/ ! They commissioned it and allowed it to be uploaded and printed by all!

Please note that they own the sole commercial right to print and sell all versions of this model, and as such no commercial use other than through them is allowed, and no remixes are allowed.

Six years ago, I remixed the very first pieces of Fukai scatter terrain from the work of AxoloteGaming and onebitpixel.
They were a raw experiment in organic, alien-inspired structures—and to my surprise, they spread across the hobby world like wildfire.
Since then, they’ve been downloaded millions of times and used to build entire themed tables.

Today, I’m bringing them back—remastered.

🔧 What’s new?

Sharper, cleaner surface lines to make painting easier (washes and drybrushes pop much better now).

More consistent detailing across each piece for a stronger visual impact.

Optimized meshes for smoother printing results.

This is just the beginning—I plan to gradually rework the entire collection to bring it up to the same standard.

And if you want to go even further into the Fukai universe, don’t miss the ongoing Kickstarter campaign:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/alario/fukai

The campaign includes a complete playable biome with modular buildings, ruins, props, and tournament-ready layouts—all designed to expand and complement the free scatter terrain.

Having been dragged into another hobby, this time in 6/8mm scale, and missing models I wanted to field I decided to model my own. As I like my greenskin models a little bigger than usual, they are more like 10mm, but hey - they're supposed to be bigger than usual 'oomies ;)

These have been printed on a resin printer and did fine (as you can see in the images). I include painted versions with the skorchas being WIP, but I will see to that soon.

In the collection you will find:
1. A tank with a long gun, great for laying down direct fire - the turret is separate from the body so you can point it straight in your opponents face ;)
2. A tank with a big gun, for sending shells overhead and smashing multiple enemies at once. There are some accessories added so no two look the same.
3. Two mobile flamethrowers - one 2-nd World War Willis style, the second a tankish ignition machine
4. A big boss on a bike with lots of dakka
5. A regular boss with an equal amount of dakka
6. A BIG WAGON with even more guns. This one has three turrets to choose from so you can customize them to your liking

Update!
7. Added three different leaders in heavy armour and some solid waponry

The battlefields of the grim-dark future are scattered will the everyday materiel of the industrial and military complex required to process war on a galactic scale.

This set offers a sample of a cargo crate, cargo hauler, blank trailer, and pallet of materiel.

These could be printed at 200% for 15mm gaming terrain, or, if you are ambitious, 400% for 28-32mm scale gaming. The models are sufficiently detailed to be printed at larger scale, yet simple and robust enough to print at their intended 6-8mm scale.

This set contains 4 STLs; a sample of the full set, available here:
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/epic-cargo-road-train-scatter-terrain-6mm-8mm-scale

The full set allows you to customise your selection. It can be used to create cargo 'road trains', linking multiple trailers and cargo containers to create thematic barriers for your miniatures to take cover behind, or individual pieces to add character to the bases of larger miniatures.

They would also make suitable 'toys' what could be added to 28-32mm scale models, adding a layer of horror and inhumanity to the devastation surrounding your grim-dark characters.

The crane and defence trailer is compatible with my other Epic tank turrets, so can be replaced with any of the turrets in this collection:

The battlefields of the grim-dark future are scattered will the everyday materiel of the industrial and military complex required to process war on a galactic scale.

This set offers a range of cargo containers, goods transport, trucks, tugs, trailers, cranes and crates to add a little more character to your battlefields and bases.

These could be printed at 200% for 15mm gaming terrain, or, if you are ambitious, 400% for 28-32mm scale gaming. The models are sufficiently detailed to be printed at larger scale, yet simple and robust enough to print at their intended 6-8mm scale.

This set contains 46 STLs, allowing you to customise your selection. It can be used to create cargo 'road trains', linking multiple trailers and cargo containers to create thematic barriers for your miniatures to take cover behind, or individual pieces to add character to the bases of larger miniatures.

They would also make suitable 'toys' what could be added to 28-32mm scale models, adding a layer of horror and inhumanity to the devastation surrounding your grim-dark characters.

The crane is compatible with my other Epic tank turrets, so can be replaced with any of the turrets in this collection:

My own take on a Super Heavy aerial transport for Space Marines dubbed the Storm Crane. Sized to be used in Epic/Legion Imperialis games.

Unique in its role, Storm Cranes are able to deliver a variety of assets to the front. From 10 fully embarked rhinos, or 4 kratos heavy battle tanks or any other armored detachment, Storm Cranes are able to bring full detachments of armor needed on the battle field. Protected by heavy plating and a pair of void shields this flyer can withstand any punishment short of anti-titan weapons. Ensuring its cargo successfully arrives where it is needed. Each Strom Crane is armed with two audax heavy bolter arrays and two titan sized havoc launchers making it a formidable assault craft that can break through enemy lines. A truly armored work horse, Space Marine legions relied heavily on these vehicles throughout the crusade and into the Heresy.


While I designed most of this using 3D Builder, I did borrow some choice parts from free kits.
Winglets/Audax Turrets from MKHand Industries
Thruster Turbine and Exhaust from IronMaster
Titan Hatch and Void Shields from Danny_Cyanide

Those same conditions also gave them Scottish accents, uncomfortably thick beards, and a strange obsession with art deco, but whatever.

Eerie in the contrast of their lethal size and silent movement, ScorpionMechs are deployed on the orbital and planetside battlefield when no quarter is to be given to the enemy, and none expected.

They're colony killers.

You send them in when you want the enemy base and any feeble defenders protecting it razed to the ground.

These scuttling terrors can chop enemy armors in half in close quarters or pound them to pieces from a distance. Using a variety of modular payloads, the ScorpionMech can tailor its weapons suite to the mission, whether it be cold, quiet up-close killing, napalm and gatling cascades at ballistic distances, or missiles beyond the horizon.

This 6/8mm scale ScorpionMech can be utilized as an attack drone against 15mm or 28mm figures with ease, or utilized in any miniatures-agnostic rule set. Or just as a keychain.

This is a fused, quarter-scale version of the 28mm version. It will be at home going into combat against tiny warmachines in the 3025 era or 40000 years from now.

Saws, claws, gatlings, flamethrowers, and gun clusters are all included in this package of STL files.

Details and links are in the included PDF instructions. If you want, you can preview them here at this WeTransfer link...

A 28mm spiderdrone looks impressive next to a 15mm human, while the 6mm spiderbots look like they can crawl over and pull down a 28mm figure.

The 28mm, multi-part versions are crafted in separate legs and blasters set at multiple angles. The 15mm and 6mm versions are tiny and fused. You can fill entire print beds with the little creepy-crawlers!

Originally created as escort bots and onboard infantry for the ScorpionMech, which I also offer, these little bots come in deployed and stowed versions, with full and empty carrier racks that can be adapted to other builds.

Death From Below! The Imperious Republican Democratic Autocratic Pneumatic Psychotic Syphilitic Hegemony spans many worlds and encompasses many races of humans, demi-humans, and aliens. One such species are the Space Dwarves, who, because of some kind of sci-fi pseudo-babble, are half the size and twice the man as most of the IRDAPPSH's average citizens. Those same conditions also gave them Scottish accents, uncomfortably thick beards, and a strange obsession with art deco, but whatever.

Why fly into battle when you can drift gently? The Space Dwarf War-Zeppelin is less a flying machine and more a floating weapons platform. Six twin batteries of "Mobile Migraine" cannons and two Infinite Repeaters provide covering fire while the War-Zeppelin maneuvers into place to drop its huge payload of earth-shattering high-explosive extremely-rude gravity bombs. The floaty part of the airship isn't simply a giant balloon; it's a honeycomb of independent pockets permanently filled with helium and surrounded by a woven plasteel envelope that is highly puncture resistant.

Don't delay! Get yours today!

Built by da biggest Mek around, the Brawla Bot is the ultimate kombo of krumpin’ power and dakka mayhem. Armed with a mix of choppy gubbinz and shooty bitz, dis hulkin' heap of scrap don’t care how it smashes – just that it does.

Whether it’s tearin' through enemy lines wiv buzzin’ blades, or lightin’ up targets from afar wiv loud, rattly shootas, da Brawla Bot is ready for any scrap. It’s got armor thicker than a squig’s skull and enough attitude to make a Warboss jealous.

Designed for tabletop mayhem and hobby fun, dis multipart kit comes with options for both melee and ranged gear – so you can pose it just right before sendin' it into a proper Waaagh!

Note: Dis is a fan-made model, full of grimy character and orkiness, but not linked to any official game or company. It’s just for da ladz who like loud machines an’ big fights.


This model is compatible to the bitz of following models:
- Mosha Bot
- Shoota Bot


======= PRINTING =========

- Layer hight 0.05mm
- Use tree / organic supports.
- I printed my test prints with a 0.25mm nozzle (for best quality)
- Orientate the Exhausts01-04 vertical

======= Assembly =========

If you need instructions - just open all files in 3D Builder or e.g. Meshmixer at the same time (drag and drop). There you can have a look where they need to go in 3D.



---
Shame less beggin' for some coins for caffeine I need doin' stuff like that :-)

Please consider a tip ....this highly detailed model was a work of hundeds of hours of free time!
If you do so, I HIGHLY APPRECIATE YOUR GENEROSITY :-)

Kind regands,
Tersus

We have so much scrap metal terrain, so we also need some suitable objective markers to make everything fit together!

There is a new terror stalking the arenas and battlefields of Junctionworld and its worldgate networks.

Eerie in the contrast of their lethal size and silent movement, ScorpionMechs are sent through hostile interdimensional portals as shock attack units, scything and slicing through any resistance on the other side.

In the Gatekeepers' colosseums of mechanized bloodsport, ScorpionMechs have quickly earned a reputation as close-quarter killers, their tail weapons well-placed to send a buzzsaw or energized claw into an opponent's cockpit, regardless of shielding.

In conventional fights, the scuttling nightmares are sometimes inserted on to the a planetside battlefield via the use of a-grav or chemical rocket packs bolted under their hulls.

They are utilized when no quarter is to be given to the enemy, and none expected.

They're colony killers. Merciless reapers. Harvesters of those foolish enough to try and face them.

Using a variety of modular payloads, the ScorpionMech pilot can tailor their unit's weapons suite to the mission, whether it be cold, quiet up-close killing, napalm and gatling cascades at ballistic distances, or missiles from beyond the horizon.

The base package for the 15mm (I use 1/100th scale) ScorpionMech includes pincers, saws, Asher claws (named for Neal Asher, whose books you should really check out), gatlings, flamethrowers, and gun clusters. Supplemental mounts are provided for heavy cannons and missile launchers.
As mentioned above, orbital assault belly packs are also included.

This is a pretty decent undertaking, not for the faint-hearted. Rest assured, though, the largest piece (the main hull) will fit in a Mars 2 or similar-sized printer.

These are remixes of the terminals by Jymacdougall, and all credit should go to him for the amazing designs. Keep in mind these are based on the Grand Master Terminals so are a bit bigger than the standard ones. For the warhound, I corrected errors in the text and modified the token slots to take 3x1mm magnets instead of pegs. The Reaver is pretty much made from scratch but printed out fine. Also included are 3 different custom tokens I made for the different tracking types.

-Resin Printers: I had some issues with warping on the edge towards the plate. To solve this, I added a break away wedge to one end. These are the STL's labelled with "R". If you angle the terminal with the wedge towards the plate, the wedge should warp instead of the terminal, then just break off the wedge when it's done.

-FDM Printers: If you want the smaller text to be legible, you're going to have to use a .2 nozzle so be prepared for a fairly long print time. Don't forget to change the settings in your slicer or risk a major clog.

I do plan on making a Warlord terminal when I get some time.

The war for Renner’s World is not going well for the embattled forces defending their home from the invading Kaiju. The abominable walking mega-fauna are now manifesting new abilities and incorporating cybernetic systems and replacement limbs, hinting at a more sinister force behind the invasion through the world-gates.

To compensate for this growing threat, the members of the Renner Defense League command staff have dusted off old plans from the Project Gigante design competition, the JagdHund, or Hunting Hound. JagdHund was a concept once deemed too large and unwieldy for the battlefield, but it has been recalled to the forefront as the threat literally grows larger.

JagdHund’s paired heavy gatling weapons are capable of dealing with hordes or point targets with equal ease, while the dorsal-mounted main gun, a superheavy maser cannon, is dedicated to frying and boiling the larger monsters emerging through the dimensional breaches. The directed energy weapon is an experiment, and has not been properly developed to withstand the rigors of close-range combat with kaiju. Plans are in the works to add different weapons and countermeasures to the JagdHund arsenal.

The majority of the Hund crews are composed of Quads, or quadruple amputees, wounded veterans and civilian volunteers who have been maimed and disfigured by the invading megafauna. Body modifications are sometimes necessary for final adjustments, but replacement limbs are provided. Quads came about originally from the Assault Raptor program, but have proved to be an invaluable asset in the fight against the invading monsters.

I made these as a resource for myself, as I want to start making up some themed bases, and need the basics in place to build on!

This is an extensive set of round and oval bases, that can be used as spares for existing minis for you to print and texture yourself, or to make life easier when designing your own scenic base STLs.

The set for magnets are also for those who wish to save a bit of resin - they have support structures underneath the base surface for added strength, with holes for 5mm x 2mm round magnets. This is my preferred magnets for magnetising bases. In case you prefer 1mm thick magnets, I've added a 'filler' that can be printed and inserted into the holes, in case it is any use. Alternatively, just use your preferred modeling putty to fill the hole, and press the magnet into it.

Small and Mean, and you can crank them out by the bushel!

The Basic Raptor in 15mm Tabletop (1/100th scale) is a starter model, a free demonstration of both the scale and the detail of my files. It can also make an easy desktop display model, without taking up too much room.

Depending on pose, height on the included 50mm base is about 2 and 5/8th inch, or 66.6mm.

If you would like the free 28mm (1/56th scale) version, click here...
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/free-project-raptor-the-basic-raptor

Check out my other mech and knight parts, most of which are free, in the other collections in my store.

https://cults3d.com/en/users/johnbearross/3d-models

------------------------

Kushal Heavy Industries, based 214 jumps deep in the Fourth Gate Network of worlds, is a renowned manufacturer of arms, both for their economy of material usage and rock bottom pricing structures.

They recently have taken their surrounding upstream and downstream neighborhood of dimensions by storm with the release of the Basic Raptor, a clean-sheet refinement of the datacore salvaged long ago from an unknown, nuked-out world.

That datacore gave the Realms Project Raptor, a broad category of light mechs that serve as scouts and fast attack platforms, taking the fight to the enemy with speed and devastating firepower.

Kushal's version is a stark, bare-bones battle platform that is intended for the customer who needs to put warheads on foreheads, without any need for frivolity, pomp, or circumstance. Or cockpit padding, as many a bruised pilot can testify.

The Basic Raptor is sneered at by some, but admired by others for its uncompromising simplicity, ruggedness, and singularity of purpose.

Many smaller defense contractors and boutique armor shops are taking stock Basic Raptors and modifying them with fancier weapons and armor packages. Assassins from the Kushal Heavy Industries Legal Department have been dispatched through the world-gates to deliver enhanced cease-and-desist notifications, to some lethal effect.

------------------------

If you like what you see, I encourage you to join my Patreon.
http://www.patreon.com/johnbearross

I give a rolling monthly 50% discount code for my entire inventory, including new releases as I put them out.

I also have a Discord, The Madness of John Bear Ross. We're a collection of mecha-heads, painters, builders, and other artists who love giant walking nightmares. Here's the invite link...
https://discord.gg/7PyEqpkARb

Enjoy!

Other mechs are shown for size ref purposes, and are available separately.

This is a set for creating a city building as a terrain for any wargame in 1/285 (6mm) scale. The set allows you to assemble both an intact (undamaged) buildings and a destroyed ones (ruins). You can assemble a building of any height you want by printing the required number of intermediate floors.


There is one option with square windows (marked with number 1) and the second with rounded windows (marked with number 2).


To make it easier to paint the windows, I made it a separate piece that can be painted in advance (for example, with spray paint) and inserted inside the walls.


I also made a set of interior parts in case you don't use windows or want to make glass from transparent material.

Death From Below! The Imperious Republican Democratic Autocratic Pneumatic Psychotic Syphilitic Hegemony spans many worlds and encompasses many races of humans, demi-humans, and aliens. One such species are the Space Dwarves, who, because of some kind of sci-fi pseudo-babble, are half the size and twice the man as most of the IRDAPPSH's average citizens. Those same conditions also gave them Scottish accents, uncomfortably thick beards, and a strange obsession with art deco, but whatever.

Another of the Space Dwarf's strange obsessions is building things HUGE, much larger than necessary. It's possible they are overcompensating for something, but on the other hand, it's possible they are overcompensating for something. The Mjölnir Mobile Fortress is a huge armored crawler capable of carrying tanks, gyrocopters, and dozens of squat troops into battle. Armed with dozens of machine guns, antitank cannons, Gatling repeaters, anti-aircraft batteries, a siege mortar, and the patent-pending "Oh God Oh God We're All Gonna Die" siege cannon, which fires a slug the size of a Volkswagen, the Mjölnir can batter its way into any stronghold and wreak short, Scottish-accented havoc on the defenders within.

Note: This model is so big that I didn't bother making an 8mm version. It should work pretty well in both scales!

Available for Deployment!

Our tiny archeologists have returned from their expedition to the tiny tank vaults and are proud to present you the ageless classic of tiny tank warfare - Sturmpanzer Mel! Named in honour of the ancient worthy, who for his skill in CAD was awarded the prestigious title of "CADor" - Mel the CADor is your number 1 choice for trench combat, prolonged sieges and general attritional warfare. The sturdy hull is provided with numerous options including:

- two different extra fuel tanks
- trench rails
- roof mounted searchlight

Furthermore our decoration team furnished optional imperial insignia to be affixed on prominent locations of your tank.

Autocannons, Laser Cannons, Heavy Gyrojets and a mighty Siege Howitzer are provided for sponson and hull mounts. The durable casemate can mount either a powerful cannon, long barreled tank killer cannon or a dual laser cannons.

In addition to that a specialized Protector variant is provided fully festooned with anti personnel weaponry for those hectic Mondays.

Furthermore all roof hatches are rendered fully operational so that you can always fulfil your urge to catch that fragrant smell of phosgene in the air.

Sturmpanzer Mel represents an exciting new chassis to be added to our tiny tank offering and is perfect for vehicular combat in 6 to 8mm scales!

Prepare for the arrival of the Dread Forces of CHAOX! CHAOX is a faction of those who are torn between being exact copies of the Imperious Forces and being spiky emo Goth kids. This dichotomy puts them into a permanently violent mood, causing them to descend upon the Imperious worlds and wreak havoc. In the infamous Battle of Nowherius, CHAOX forces covertly swapped the Imperious Forces' regular coffee for decaf. The casualty count reached the low billions. Billions!

The CHAOX Hellifiknow is a ground-attack fighter built for one specific thing: killing tanks! Built around a wicked, heavy, tri-barrel, armor-piercing, plasma-core, sustainably-sourced, fair trade, dolphin-safe, hand-crafted artisanal autocannon, the Hellifiknow swoops down on enemy armor and rips it to pieces! As an added bonus, it looks damn sexy while doing it.

Note: This package includes both the classic 6mm/Epic scale and the newer 8mm/AT18 scale models!

Easy to print, FDM-friendly Pillbug (land isopods, roly-polys, etc) companions!

These are meant for tabletop roleplaying games such as D&D, Pathfinder, etc, but can be used for whatever you wish.

These giant fantasy isopods (don't at me about anatomy) are available in multiple flavors, including smooth, saddled, and cannoned.

The cannon prints separately (print the cannon oriented vertically with the mouth touching the build plate) and snaps into place, and includes a small prop crate of cannonballs.

They have been sized as Medium-sized (fits on a 1 inch / 25.4mm round base) creatures, but if you scale them up by about 150% they would work fine as Large creatures (Fits on a 2 inch / 50.8mm round base).

They print with minimal supports and should be quite sturdy, even with a 0.4mm nozzle.
They will look best printed in resin, or with a 0.2mm nozzle for fine details.
Example prints were printed at 0.16mm layer heights with a 0.4mm nozzle.

Simple supports will be needed on the cannon pivot points; be sure to cut or file down the contact point with supports.


[If you liked this model and want to show your thanks, you can buy me a coffee!](https://ko-fi.com/clayrade)

[And follow me on Instagram!](https://www.instagram.com/clay.rade/)

This file is another remix/remaster of a file made by [TheDude21](https://www.thingiverse.com/thedude21/designs) (check him out and give him a tip, if you like). Much like the previous Glade-S, I very much liked the core Cyberpunk stylings of this vehicle concept and thought that it would make a nice adaption into a 'lower' tech level universe setting as a civilian hovercraft vehicle at the 6mm scale setting.

**About the Design.** Despite the superficial resemblance's to the original design, this project actually took quite a lot of time to remaster, because I wanted to remove as many of the 'hard-angle' edges as possible. This should make the model much better to orientate for supports and 3D print on a resin system. (zoom right in on the file to compare it with the original, if you like!)

**Other Designs.** This model set is intended to be compatible with the other 6mm (true-scale) and Hex(33) (hex scale) SciFi terrain sets that I have released on [Cults 3D](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Shiaic3D/creations) and other locations, [GumRoad](https://shiaic3d.gumroad.com/), [Printables](https://www.printables.com/@Shiaic3D/models) and [Thingiverse](https://www.thingiverse.com/shiaic1/designs).

Please search my other designs for more models of a similar type and theme.

**Glade-S, civilian HC**

This file is a remix & remaster of a file originally made by [Pietia](https://www.thingiverse.com/Pietia). I had looked at this 28mm scale model Cyberpunk Sci-Fi car and thought that it would be a cool design to adapt and remix as a civilian-model Sci-Fi hover car for use at 6mm scale.

**About the Design.** I have taken the original 3D model by Pieta and remastered it slightly, adapting it more for the 6mm scale size where some of the detail at 28mm scale was either redundant or required some further adjusting to account for detail creep or dissolution (if printed). I then created the Hovercraft 'skirt' separately and melded these two main feature components together. Finally, I created some other new detail features as well as further adjusting some of the existing features to bring it all together more holistically as an integrated overall design that works on its own.

And voila! hopefully, it does.

**Available for Deployment!**

Our staff of dedicated tiny boffins had not sat idle and is proud to announce the latest and greatest in the tiny MBT scene - our new Apex MBT series. These high quality tanks are festooned with everything an enterprising tiny panzer general could ever desire. Elegant hull comes with two weapon option along with optional trench rails and engine filtration system for all your trench warfare needs! Equally as impressive is turret weaponry - of which 7 novel and brand new options are provided including:

- Standard cannon
- Extralong tank killer cannon
- Dual autocannon
- Dual laser cannon
- Siege howitzer
- Plasma projector
- Thermal ray emitter

All existing sponson weapon options are generously included.

Additional are provided for tiny tank connoisseurs. Furthermore, you will be glad to find our turret hatches completely operational (saber wielding psychopath not included).

Our long time fans will be delighted to know that this tank's turrets are fully interchangeable with the previous releases in tiny mbt family.

This vehicle is perfect for tiny combat in 6 to 8 mm scale!

A complete collection of retro-themed Gothic Ruins for table top gaming. These are the full set of 20 ruins that make up the full set of the sample set released earlier, available here: https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/retro-gothic-corner-ruins-set-1

Included in this set are 20 corner ruins, the floor piece for the raised platform on the two tallest corner ruins, plus two floor templates in case anyone wants to break them up a bit for some floor details on the ground level.

Inspired by the cardboard terrain I used in my youth, these turn those 2D flat terrain pieces into fully 3D models, to look more fitting on a modern gaming table!

Scaled to suit 28mm-32mm models, I actually designed them to be printed out at 50% scale for 15mm gaming. They even work well all the way down to 25% scale for 8mm gaming!

Perfect for reliving past wargaming experiences, or for giving your current games a bit of a Retro theme!

Please check out my other wargaming models including the first part of this set, and if you like this set, please consider liking the file, following me, or even making a donation! I love seeing what people do with my models, so please post a make once you've printed them out. I am an amateur, hobby-level designer, and any support helps keep me motivated and supports the hobby activities I can do! Thanks!

Rumbling forward on heavy tracks, the tanks of the Imperial Army are capable of decimating enemy forces with overwhelming firepower. The versatile main battle tank hull is capable of being adapted to feature a wide range of alternate patterns - including devastating artillery.

This set of 79 STLS, and features the heavy 'Bombardier' tank, the long range 'Basil' tank, and the medium 'Euryale' tank, each with variants with and without bulldozer blade, and variants with holes onto which plastic open hatches from comparable plastic tank kits are compatible. There are also additional hull variants, of each tank, including an Imperial Army Bombardier tank, and hulls with extra armour, plus some kit form Bombardiers. Also included are a range of an optional details, including rear-mounted mounted dozer blade (enabling the artillery to 'dig in' prior to firing), rear mounted trailers, support struts, and shells that can be used to add features to any bases you wish to mount the tanks on.

This set has been made to be compatible with 8mm scale main line battle tanks of the Imperial Army in a recently released 8mm grim-dark future wargame.

This is a single hull sample of a set of tank hulls featuring 8 base hull designs - The full set contains a Destroyer hull, Thunderer hull, Flamer hull, laser cannon hull, heavy bolt hull, automatic cannon hull, and two support variant hulls. Each of these come with bulldozer blade and ram bar options. Each of the standard tank hull designs also comes with options for two different sponson designs (square and inset versions) , with holes for magnetisation. Let's face it: Even in the far future, people are still obsessed with efficiency, doing more with less. So it is with maintaining the Imperious Leader's far-flung dominion, and the most efficient method of moving stuff is still the train. And when you have enemies, those trains make sweet, juicy targets, necessitating adding arms and armor to repel the bad guys.

This set includes not only nine different train cars, but compatible track segments. The various train cars have round guide lugs on the underside that serve to keep the cars centered on the tracks.

The GothiTech Armored Train includes:

- Armed Locomotive
- Flatbed Car
- Boxcar
- Tanker Car
- Passenger Car
- Nuclear Fuel Car
- Artillery Car (cannon prints separately and can be mounted up for firing or down for travel)
- Troop Car (includes mounting points for two turrets)
- Air Defense Car (includes two antiaircraft missile turrets)
- Five Track Segments (Straight Single, Curved Single, Y-Split, Straight Double, and Curved Double)

Ok, so there are many ways to confiture the Malc, so here are a few of them. I did variants based on the combinations of the mainguns (Vanquisher, Battle Cannon, and Double LasCans with 3 different hull guns (lascanon, HvyBolter, Demolisher) and the 2 different sponsons of Autocannons and LasCans.

These STLs have been painstakingly repaired/ filled and then had the underneath scooped out to reduce suction.

Now, if the one you are seeking doesn't quite exist, just open them into 3D builder and cut/paste to your hearts desire. Its pretty easy - plenty of tutorials on the tube of YOU.

These models are all ultimately based on Danny_Cyanide's work. They were reduced in scale and assembled by Korgaan, but had a lot of internal hollow (especially around the sides/ tracks) that needed to be filled. I did a ton of repair work. Other creators have worked on these prior, but I noticed there were still internal hollows, so the ones here should be a better print with a lower chance of resin leakage - it is difficult to take multi-part STLs and assemble a single print model without some stuff missed - so this is not in any way a criticism of those fine works.

There are 8 tanks here:
BattleTurret with AutoCannonSpn and HvyBolterHull
BattleTurret with LasCannonSpn and HvyBolterHull
BattleTurret with LasCannonSpn and DemolisherHull
DblLasCaneTurret with LasCannonSpn and DemolisherHull
DblLasCaneTurret with LasCannonSpn and HvyBolterHull
DblLasCaneTurret with LasCannonSpn and LascanonHull
VanqTurret with LasCannonSpn and DemolisherHull
VanqTurret with LasCannonSpn and LascanonHull

This posting is not in anyway an invite for "aktually - sniff - blah blah blah" type of comments. People that think that way are typically not the subject matter experts they want to be on the internets. Either get off the internet or if you can do it better - do it.

+++ Berserks units are made up from assault squads of the mos ferocious hand-to-hand fighters in the Stronghold. Armed with bolt pistols and power axes, theyre experts tunnel fighters and excel at clearing buildings and fortifications ahead of the Brotherhood´s advance. All squats are doughty fighters in close combat, but the Berserks units are renowed for their tneacity and courage against even the mightiest opponents without thought for their own looses.

By tradition, Berserkers often wear a striking crest dyed bright red, which is why they refuse to wear combat helmets. The origins of this practice have been lost in the mists of time, but what for many Imperial officers could be an absurd and tactically reprehensible risk, for the Squats is definitive proof of the courage of the Berserkers and their attitude of always spitting in death´s face.+++

I have had these models ready for quite some time, and in fact I also have them printed, but due to lack of time I have not been able to mount and paint them properly to take nice pics.

As I am currently focused on finishing my squat miners (among other lesser things such as graduating from university), I don't think I will resume my Epic Squats in the short term, so I have decided to upload these Berserkers models once and for all and thus finish the infantry forces at least.

Finally this guys come in two flavours: with a boltpistol/power axe combo, and the classic dual wield boltpistols. This is a simple aestetic choice to give variety to the squads.

This locally-produced heavy fighter, distantly related to the more commonly encountered Thunderbolt, featured heavily in the closing days of the imperial civil war. With poor maneuverability at low altitudes and a dangerously exposed propulsion system, the craft was poorly suited for ground attack work. However, its speed and performance at high altitudes, combined with a pair of lethally accurate long-barreled autocannons made the fighter especially dangerous when either escorting or intercepting bombers and reconnaissance aircraft. Fighting on both sides during the conflict, it was ultimately a shortage of pilots with combat experience that led to horrific casualty rates among its pilots.

Compatible with any 8mm scale wargame. Fits most standard flight stands. Comes in air and ground versions with a variety of ordnance.

Painted miniature courtesy of VarianceHammer.com

+++ Traditionally the elite warriors known as the Hearthguards accompany the Warlord as his personal bodyguards, however their duties do not end there. Hearthguards who are not in the direct service of the Warlord take the position of platoon "captains", leading troops directly into battle. Only when a Hearthguard has proven to be a charismatic leader, a resourceful strategist, and a skilled warrior, he can be considered to be part of the Warlord's personal guard in the future.

The Hearthguards go into battle accompanied by an retinue of warriors selected from among the most skilled and trusted veterans, as they carry valuable weapons known as "heirloom weapons." These weapons are evidence of the maximum skill of the squat artificers, surpassing in every aspect their more common equivalents, and many of them have been in service of the squat noble families for centuries and some even millennia. +++

This is a Squat Hearthguard unit designed for NetEpic Armageddon, in specific for the Grindel Sronghold army list that you can find here: https://tacticalwargames.net/taccmd/viewtopic.php?f=134&t=33281&sid=422418b4bea515739e1aef8d862588e5

I designed 3 Hearthguard models, all equiped with a plasma and volkite pistols. Also i included a banner-bearer squat.

You can complete the unit using the warriors models that i already uploaded.

+++ The "Knarr" pattern is a variant of the Rhino APC specially designed by and for squats. All its internal layout, instruments and technical characteristics have been modified and adapted for the needs (and size) of the squats, so that the vehicle is uncomfortable and even impossible to use by other abhumans, normal humans and much less by Astartes, but for squats it is such a comfortable, spacious and versatile vehicle that many agree that they could live in them if it were possible. And some actually do.+++

This is a Epic size Rhino APC designed for the Grindel Sronghold army list that you can find here: https://tacticalwargames.net/taccmd/viewtopic.php?f=134&t=33281&sid=422418b4bea515739e1aef8d862588e5

+++ The individuals known as Grand Warlords are rarely seen, appearing only in the largest of battles where their great tactical skill and commanding presence are necessary to control a vast army of countless soldiers and monstrous war engines. The title itself is temporary, lasting for the duration of the campaign and generally being awarded to a warlord who stands out above the rest due to his martial achievements, although it is also possible that the Stronghold Lord himself is the one who wears the powerful Exo-armor distinctive of the Great Warlord. However, although it grants great honor and renown, it is a position that implies tremendous responsibility that not everyone is willing to assume or able to fulfill, and for a Great Warlord defeat in battle means ruin and contempt for his clan for generations.

The Living Ancestors are the oldest individuals in Squat society, who form the basis of their religion. For all intents and purposes, the Living Ancestors have abandoned their previous life and identity and are now regarded as vessels of the spirits of the deceased, who observe and judge all the actions of the Squats. In battle they provide wisdom and advice for leaders, and physical support for warriors, because their long life (or perhaps also due to the influence of spirits) has allowed them to develop psychic powers which focus on defense and healing, but they are not completely incapable of attacking if they are forced to do so, although with much disgust. +++


These are a Epic scale Squat Grand Warlord and a Living Ancestor for the Grindel Sronghold army list that you can find here: https://tacticalwargames.net/taccmd/viewtopic.php?f=134&t=33281&sid=422418b4bea515739e1aef8d862588e5

They are considered characters, which means that they do not form individual units but must join an existing one. As you can see in the photos, I attached them to a Warlord unit, because I think it makes sense, but they are not restricted to this unit only.

+++ Warlord is the title of Squat commanders. Warlords are close relatives of Stronghold Lords, and take command of a Stronghold's Brotherhood in battle. On the battlefield he is accompanied by a unit of elite warriors knows as Hearthguard, each one drawn from the Lord's loyal retainers, who formed an aristocratic class in Squat Strongholds. +++


This is a Squat Warlord unit designed for NetEpic Armageddon, in specific for the Grindel Sronghold army list that you can find here: https://tacticalwargames.net/taccmd/viewtopic.php?f=134&t=33281&sid=422418b4bea515739e1aef8d862588e5

The list does not consider the classic Squats exosuits, which gave me some creative freedom and I decided that both the warlord and his hearthguard would be equipped with power armor, for which I used (again) the fantastic models designed by Toftylicious. This also opens the possibility of creating an Epic scale army of squat marines in the distant (grimdark) future.

I have designed two warlord models, one with a thunder hammer and one with a power axe; two hearthguard models, although the difference is almost imperceptible; and a banner-bearing hearthguard.

About the very small supports, i placed each one by hand so probably many are redundant or totally unnecesary for the model size, but overall they gave good results on printing.

These are remixes from Vohvel's excellent originals:

https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4862377

I've used some other bits and bobs also, such as JayMull420's glyphs and Alpokemon's quite frankly wonderful chibi tiger:

https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4694469

https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:2391204

I did these a couple of years ago so I may have forgotten someone's bits: please let me know if so. I'm a bit of a noob with MeshMixer so, again, apologies if for anything messy. I've basically embedded guns in the front, added peg-turrets and given lots of glyph/no glyph [clean] options. They've all printed fine my end so fingers crossed yours. If you have problems with the pegs not fitting the holes properly then just resize the turrets a bit as some resins cure with odd dimensions. These are re-sized to what I think orks should roughly be on the Moonjammy scale (so 90% of Vohvel's originals)? Hope you enjoy using them to munch humies. Waaagh!

UPDATE: 2023-10-11
I didn't expect quite so many downloads so to I've done some extra bits last night that I was going to leave till Christmas. Essentially just some fiddling to create more variety (orks don't really do 'standardised', do they :) ?). More glyph options (the numbers correlate with those in JayMull420's pack for those wanting to fiddle more), some new turrets and, crucially, bolted versions of the dozer glyphs in addition to the welded. Thingiverse couldn't cope with one zip file so I've done three. Hope you enjoy them and any donations to the originators listed above, please, rather than me. Cheers.

The Empire of Sentient Man has the diverse army taking part in permament war against the foul traitors and treacherous aliens. Mostly, the army is represented by ill-equipped militia in various ballistic armour (including coats), wielding only laser rifles. Red Militia has such a tragic fate. While being the defenders of their land, they have to reach the planets too far beyond comprehension, test the mud with their boots and treads and hope for weapons to beat unfamiliar threats.

The Red Militia models, with faces diminished and bases added, are shared for free with the permission of NotANiceGuy (https://cults3d.com/en/users/NotANiceGuy/3d-models).

The pack contains:
- command squad including lieutenant, communication officer, standard bearer and sergeant;
- line infantry in 8 different poses;
- heavy weapons teams with heavy machine gun, automatic gun, laser cannon, missile launcher;
- random loaders and mortar crew;
- plus non-Red Militia 3 commissars and 2 psykers.

UPDATE 2023.08.15:
- added separate heavy weapons;
- improved missile launcher crew, version two added;
- mortars added.

UPDATE 2023.12.14:
- Master of Discipline model added;
- All the Red Militia are downscaled to fit 8mm scale;
- All the weapons on carriages are downscaled;
- New Missile Launcher team for nostalgic feels.

Pictures with resin prints of pre-release version of 8mm Red Militia models included. The current models have sturdier bases, and the standard bearer got thicker banner pole.

This cobbled-together flying piece of scrap metal looks as if it should fall apart under a gentle breeze. And yet, it barrels through the air with wild abandon; bullets, bombs and stranger projectiles flying from it in all directions. A mighty flying fortress, this super-scrap bomber all but ignores incoming fire as it passes harmlessly through open superstructure, or as it blasts away rusty plating that was all but falling off anyway, leaving critical structures safe below layers of bolted on scrap metal.

This 67 piece multi-part kit comes with a huge range of options. It can be built with two wing profiles, alternative hulls with differing tailfins, and a range of options for turrets and bombs, many of which can be mirrored for additional variety / symmetry. It includes monstrous 'bouncing bombs' for some truly 'wild' bombing runs!

The kit is designed to be scaled to 8mm scale model games, such as plane warfare games, or those featuring legions of models fighting. It could also be used in 6mm games where Epic Marines fight in Space, a real armageddon level battle. Compatable with ork style armies, it would be a great proxy for a mega bommber or landa. It is sufficiently detailed that an ambitious hobbyist could print it at 400% scale to create a huge center piece model or terrain for 32mm games set in grim dark universes. This would of course require additional cuts to the model!

I am a hobbyist 3D modeller - not a professional 3D designed. However, this project has taken many, many hours of development, test printing and correction. It is my first 'paid for' model, a reflection of the time it took to create. Almost all my other models are currently available for free, so please do look through those if you are interested in further supporting me and my hobby.

I also welcome feedback and will look to develop this model with improvments and additional options in future.

"'Ere We Go, 'Ere We Go, 'Ere We Go!"
— Common Ork chant heard during a Greenskin WAAAGH!
The Orks, also called Greenskins, are a savage, warlike, green-skinned race of humanoids who are spread all across the Milky Way Galaxy. They share many features with Warhammer Fantasy Orcs (and were initially called "Space Orcs" to distinguish them). They are seen by their enemies (pretty much everyone else in the universe) as savage, warlike, and crude, but they are the most successful species in the whole galaxy, outnumbering possibly every other intelligent race, even Mankind (with the very plausible exception of the Tyranids).

Greenskins are one of the most dangerous alien races to plague the galaxy. Numerous beyond belief and driven always to fight and conquer, the Orks threaten every single intelligent species of the galaxy. Orks are possibly the most warlike aliens in the 41st Millennium, and their number is beyond counting. Amid constant, seething tides of war and bloodshed, burgeoning Ork stellar empires rise and fall. Mercifully most are short-lived, soon destroying themselves in a maelstrom of violence and internecine conflict, but should the Orks ever truly unify, they would crush all opposition.

The Orks' unquenchable thirst for battle has always proved their downfall: historically, the Ork tribes have spent much of their time fighting amongst themselves, waging brutal wars with only the strongest surviving. On occasion, an Ork leader will emerge who is mighty enough to defeat his rivals and unite the warring tribes. His success draws other tribes to him, and soon a great WAAAGH! is underway -- partly a migration, partly a holy war that can exterminate the populations of entire star systems. When the Orks are on the rampage, the galaxy trembles, and in these dark days of the End Time, there are more WAAAGH!s rising than ever before recorded.

There have been woolly, tusked Squiggoths seen on battlefields, but the most common appears similar to a dinosaur. It commonly has a howdah on its back, where boyz ride into battle, shooting mounted guns, such as the Supa-lobba as they go. To protect their "ride", Orks usually add armour plating.

As with all Greenskin organisms, the Magos Biologis of the Adeptus Mechanicus have identified Squiggoth's as fungal lifeforms, though they are fairly rare and can only be grown by the specialist breeder Pigdok of the Snakebites Clan. The size of the Squiggoth is determined by the effectiveness of the feed-formula the breeder gives his creature. Less-effective formulas may result in puny Squiggoths while high-quality formulas will see them keep growing and growing.

Squiggoths themselves vary in size and shape, but there are two primary subspecies:

Big Squiggoths are the smaller but more common breed of Squiggoths, either young or whose breeding and feed were less effective and have stunted growth. They most often travel in packs.
Gargantuan Squiggoths are monsterous creatures the size of a small Imperial Titan, bred from the finest secret feed-formulas of the Snake Bites Clan. They are sometimes the favored steeds of powerful Ork Warbosses.

Update: I changed them to be 2mm high, the bottom is now 0,4mm high and the outer walls still 0,8.
They're now perfect to print with a 0,4mm nozzle and 0,2mm layer height.
I added all the earlier 1,5mm versions to a zip file, they still work perfectly fine.

Annoyed by having to fill the little gaps on hole bases for infantry models or by adding to much mass on top when adding more creative base designs?
Look no further! These bases have huge holes instead of small ones, so you can just fill the entire top of the base with Green Stuff/Milliput/Tamiya-Putty or whatever you like!

They're probably best printed with FDM but they should also work with SLA printers, I only tested them with FDM so far.

!MAKE SURE TO LET THEM COOL OFF INSTEAD OF PULLING THEM OFF THE BUILDPLATE WHILE THEY'RE STILL WARM OR THEY WILL END UP BEING BENT!

I used pretty old dried up Green Stuff for the example picture, so please excuse that it looks terrible.

If you want any other size just post a coment and I'll make it for you.

A pair of simple retro-style sci fi cactuses for tabletop RPGs and wargames.

I designed these for a 15mm scale project I'm working on, for which I print them at 50% scale. These are scaled to be 40mm and 60mm (ish) tall when printed at 100%, so would work for 28mm-32mm scale miniatures. However, they are intentionally simple and chunky, both to have they retro feel and to work when scaled down. They should work at anything down to 25% scale, if you fancied some spikey plants for your 8mm games!

Great for retro themed grim dark scifi terrain, for games such as 40k, SW Legions, etc.

Please see my other models and consider donating.

Here's my set of modular building elements that allows you to build gothic-like structures for your wargaming terrain. I designed it for FDM printers.

The initial idea was to be able to create simple gothic-like walls in both undamaged and damaged form, so this is the reason why there are no floor tiles just yet.

There are no fancy connecting mechanism - use the glue, Luke! I prefer to use quick-drying basing glue.

**1.0v - Initial Release**

- Includes 27 wall and column modules.

**Updates**

- 18-07-2023: after some more printing, I can confirm that resizing the modules down to 80% still works great. I can also confirm that the modules print easily on a resin printer - with no supports, placed directly on the build plate. To save resin, you can hollow the columns (don't forget to add the drainage holes).

When building Gore Krusha Mega Walkers, greenskin Meks sometimes opt to build massive klanky klaws as melee weapons instead of the often-seen giant saws.


FOR BEST QUALITY PRINT, PLEASE READ ALL(!) OF BELOW:

This highly detailed Klaw Arm is compatible to my Gore Krusha's Mega Walker
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/gore-krusha-mega-walker

I REALLY recommend a layer high of 0.050 or lower for all parts to get the quality I intended.
Please see the pics of my print, those are all in FDM (0,05mm layer height)!

I tried to keep the need of tree supports low, but I recommend it to use them on some parts - decide for yourself & make sure to set the tree support z-distance to a multiple of 2 (layer height) for optimal removal (keep in mind: layer height 0.05 to 0.075(!) )


----------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------- EXCEPTIONAL 'fings for this model: --------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------

---------- MOVABLE PARTS ----------
- Most pivot points are actually functional, pose the arm as you want!
- I have included a functional hydraulics option for the klaw, so it can move once assembled.
 -> You need a well calibrated printer to get this hydraulics working. Print all *FlexHydraulics*.stl with wallcount = e.g. 99 to get a massive print without infill.
 -> For the FlexHydraulics pins you need to cut of ca. 10mm of regular 1,75mm filament. (I did not test this in resin, but I guess you could print them)
 -> As an option to the FlexHydraulics there are two fixed versions. Have a look in the parts.
- Print all PINS with wallcount = e.g. 99 to get a massive print without infill.

---------- CABLES and WIRES ----------

KlawArm_03 Bits come with an option to glue in some wires (or filament).
If you use some 0,75mm² or 0,5mm² electrical wires the arm could still be movable :)

---------- Arm on the LEFT or RIGHT? ----------
You can print all parts normally except the shoulder pauldrons. (because of the flat printing side)
-> You have to mirror both pauldrons if you want the arm on the left side of your model (from your point of view)

---------- ASSEMBLY ----------

If you need instructions - just open all files in 3D Builder or e.g. Meshmixer. There you can look where they need to go.

---------- FOLLOWING: ----------

Shame less beggin' for some coins for caffeine I need doin' stuff like that :-)

Please consider a tip ....this highly detailed model was a work of 80h+ of free time!
If you do so, I HIGHLY APPRECIATE YOUR GENEROSITY :-)

Tersus

This was designed in TinkerCAD Codeblocks so that is can be easily adjusted to fit the size you want.

The idea to glue the 3D printed dome base onto a washer for weight, and glue a nail into the hole in the dome.

Provides a version of Woddish's excellent Tiny Tank Classic Mbt (now gone), KMFP proto-rhino concept, and a Scorpios launcher of unknown source, and a radar from Chris John, that have been sliced into major parts that are enabled to be quickly swapped and edited for customization by changing visibility of components between different options for hatches, side doors, symbols/icons, and crew. The eventual end game would be the ability to build any Deimos based Monoceros chassis vehicle with this tool.

This is intended for designers and modelers to product their own faction customized vehicles from in a standardized and high quality form.

If you like what I did and want to leave a tip it would be appreciated.
https://paypal.me/jimmyzimms

Edit 20220526: Found some flipped normals I missed and a couple of positioning errors so corrected. Since 3D Builder gets annoyed about nonmanifold object and does the wrong thing occasionally I've updated all the parts, even if it shouldn't matter.

Edit 20230112: Added a slicer for the side doors to the blender file that can be used by designers to make form fitting symbols from that can be set into the hatches.

Edit 20230426: Added support for KMFP's nifty 3rd edition style Whirlwind Launcher

Edit 20230519: With permission, incorporated thewraeththu's better Scorpius into the builder.

Edit 20230908: Updated the Scorpius launcher to have an upper deck based on the Deimos predator. This better matches to the updated plastic kit from GW.

Edit 20240117: Minor cleanup

Edit 20240518: For those that like rivets and bolts, two sets (based on the geometry of each glacis option) have been added to adorn your tanks with tons of extra! Thanks TC63 for the contributions!

Edit 20241027: Added in crew from the Rapax From Deimos builder here.

The All-Purpose Carrier lives up to its name as a rugged and dependable platform that has been adapted to almost every role on & off the battlefield.

This all-in-one package of M'khand-pattern All-Purpose Carrier parts allows you to build your ideal APC-based vehicle to your exact needs. Contains all previously released APC-chassis related files***, both free and paid, adapted to 1:300 scale for mass-scale wargames.

Turrets and middles have 2.5x1.25mm holes for magnets. Compatible with all epic scale M'khand-pattern APC & Lemoine Russel turrets.

To use meshmixer builder, open with meshmixer (a free program from autodesk) and ctrl-click in the object browser the items you wish to have as one piece. Then go to File and Export. Your merged piece is ready for repair and slicing.

Alternatively, individual part stls can be assembled in 3Dbuilder or another program of your choice where they should snap together.

***Non-IFV turrets, Christie suspension sides and artillery cannons for unarmoured hulls not included***

2022-12-30: Added track guards to the builder.

2022-12-30: Added new options for sponson and hull-mounted weapons.

2024-01-23: Added missing armoured artillery mounts and cannons.

2024-09-26: Added hatches for side weapon arrays

An improved pattern of the M'khand Pattern Lemoine Russel Battle Tank, with improved suspension and internal layout offering more crew comfort and higher accuracy when firing on the move. Comes with all turret coxial and sponson weapon options offered at larger scales for maximum customisation.

Completed bodies, turrets and middles have 2.5x1.25mm holes for magnets. Compatible with all epic scale M'khand-pattern Lemoine Russel parts and variants. Comes with a variety of decals and effects.

The zip includes all my parts and meshmixer files. With Meshmixer (free program from Autodesk), simply Shift+Click the pieces you want to use and select export under the FILE dropdown menu. Alternatively, parts can be assembled via 3dBuilder, Blender or another software of your choice. Exported pieces are then ready for repair in netfab/3dbuilder/prusaslicer and slicing.

For best results when printing destroyed turrets, include a closed hatch with the turret, weapon and smoke to prevent a small pocket of unprinted resin.

__For printing for LIMP/AT18, increase scale to 125% when slicing__

2023-12-03: Added new options for side weapons and a builder with all my other lemoine russel variants in it.

2023-12-07: Added adapters to fit the turrets to plastic LIMP hulls. Combine with other wanted parts before scaling up 125%

2023-12-07: Split hull weapon mounts from the hulls. Added new hull weapon options. Removed the old redundant builder file.

2024-01-14: Added coronal-designations of the three patterns of turret as well as both a turret-mounted heat ray and heavy flamethrower.

2024-08-24: Added internal side sponsons.

I hate clear plastic flight stands. They are brittle and they break. And the model ends up top heavy.

This flight stand incorporates a wide base, hefty fillet, and the stem is reinforced with a nail.

The idea is that you put a magnet into the bottom of the model stand stick to the head of the nail at the top of the stem.

Quite a bit larger than an Imperial Baneblade, a Kill Grinda Mega Fortress is truly a fearsome idol of the brutish Ork gods:
On massive, krushin' trakks, armed with weapons capable of destroying entire hab blocks with one shot, they rumble onwards, where da fORKtress Kaptains points them to.
Only the most powerful Warbosses have 'nuff teef to pay the bestest meks to build these mega-super-heavy assault vehicles.

An IMPORTANT note for the scale :D
- Quote of an imperial agent during a massive Ork encounter on Fungusius Primus:
"Big Mek Gutgrinda once build this thing at a scale of a Baneblade (~79%).... he was KRUSHED and GRINDED brutally to deff by WAAAGHBOSS Gobba Gitkrusha's 'GORKAfORKress' (100% scale)" ;-)



----------------------------------------------------------------------
------- FOR BEST PRINT QUALITY , PLEASE READ ALL(!) OF BELOW: --------
----------------------------------------------------------------------

I REALLY recommend a layer hight of 0.075 or lower for all parts to get the quality I intended.
Please see the pics, those are all printed in FDM (<=0,075mm)!

All parts are printed without tree supports, some parts don't need supports, but please decide for your self. :)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
---------------- EXCEPTIONAL 'fings for this model: ------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------

---------- Over all printing recommendation! ----------

Many parts have a "flat surface" -> face those to the build plate. Keep in mind, the z-axies does the detailed job!
Detailed sides / most visible sides should be faced towards the cooling fan.

The supa gattla can fit two 5x3mm magnet to be rotatable. The "KillGindaMegaFortress_SupaGattla_Pin.stl" does a similar job, but not as good, I guess... although I never tested the magnets.

The main gun can be assembled in 3 ways:
- Mega Zzappa
- Nukular Shell (with or without spacer, as you like)
- None of both

I printed the supa gattla ammo without a raft, but if you have problems with adhesion, use a raft.
-> If you have concerns about the sharp corners of the ammo belt in FMD, you have the right feeling, but "in the end it doesn't matter", you will not see this issue after assembly.
-> enable "print thin walls" in cura or equivalent in your slicer.

Arrange the lobbas ("KillGrindaMegaFortress_Lobbas02 - 07 & _LazerMarker) as you like, view all files in e.g. 3D Builder or Meshmixer to see how I designed them. The "Lazer sight"-bit is optional, you can replace it with an additional lobba as you like.

---------- Assembly ----------

All parts have a arritation point, so just "move" them until they snap or feel right.
- If you need instructions: just open all files in 3D Builder or e.g. Meshmixer. There you can look where all parts belong to.


---------- FOLLOWING: ----------

Shame less beggin' for some coins for coffein I need doin' stuff like that :-)

Please consider a tip ....this highly detailed model was a work of 100h+ of free time!
If you do so, I HIGHLY APPRECIATE YOUR GENEROSITY :-)

Kind regards,
Tersus

Want to fire some flesh eatin' short range artillery ammunishun that's not a bug?? Rukka Buggys are your vehicle of choice! Slap it! Expolode it!
"How much bity or 'splodin' flesh balls you want to shoot??" - "Yes."


FOR BEST QUALITY PRINT, PLEASE READ ALL(!) OF BELOW:

To print the Rukka Buggy, you need time or a resin printer ;-)
I REALLY recommend a layer high of 0.075mm or lower for all parts to get the quality I intended.
Please see the pics, those are all printed in FDM (<=0,075mm)!

I highly recommend it to use tree supports (at least on the crew) - make sure to set the tree support z-distance to a multiple of 2 (layer hight) for optimal removal (keep in mind: layer hight 0.05 (crew) or 0.075mm (buggy))

---------- Over all printing recommendation (FDM) ----------

- Many parts have a flat surface -> face those to the build plate. Print slow (25mm/s)
- Detaild sides / most visible sides should be faced towards the cooling fan.
- Crew should be printed with tree supports, rotated 45° back (so the face is up). Support Z-distance should be a multiple of 2 to 3 of the layer hight (0.05 - 0.075mm). PRINT SLOW - Outer wall max 25mm/s. You want dem details gooood!

The most difficult parts (actually not the Gobbo Crew...):
- "RuckaBuggy_Rear_02.stl": you need to be super carefull to remove tree supports (they are needed). My test print broke on the bars while removing them. I was able to glue it back on (tip: smooth cracks with a lighter)
- "RuckaBuggy_Front_04.stl": failed 4 times while removing tree supports, combined with other parts. I needed to print this part as a single part with normal supports.

---------- Assembly ----------

If you need instructions - just open all files in 3D Builder or e.g. Meshmixer. There you can look where they go.
Some parts are press fits (e.g. the wheels) you don't need to glue them, unless you print in resin (not tested).
I recommend to "dry fit" the parts with blu tack or a similar reusable putty.


---------- FOLLOWING: ----------

These containers and handling equipment make a great container yard terrain setup, or just lots of small vehicles and scatter terrain to give your battlefields some life.

Models include:
The big stationary container crane is presented in several models, with the container 'rack' in different positions. A seperate part is included for a container hanging from cables.

Quad mech 'walking' container cranes in several models. They can also use the hanging container part if you print the version with no rack. (Its another quad industrial mech!)

The container Train is a multi-part model of a tractor and one or more trailers to make up a 'train' that is meant to service the stationary cranes. Empty trailers are included along with those loaded with one or two containers.

Container Stackers are trucks with piston lifts that allow them to drive over single containers, or lift high enough to double-stack. Handy for moving containers but can't stack as high as the big walking cranes.

Container skates are a variation of the mech skates (see the mech repair posting!) either loaded or unloaded; they're an alternative to the trains for moving containers and look best when being loaded/unloaded by the walking cranes.

Container stacks in different configurations and heights, along with a few single containers.

A Buildermech with a container flatbed is also included (See my Buildermech posting for lots of other options - the crane version would also be handy in a container yard. Also, see my modular ships to have something the big cranes can offload!

Modeled in 6mm scale.

Originally designed as an upgrade to a Factory kit, Project Abby has now been sculpted to be its own full frame, armor, weaponry, and escort drones.
Past purchasers of the Project Abby (check the URL) upgrade kit are now rewarded for their early support with a free upgrade.
Thank you very much!

----------------------------

With the mysterious Dark Powers making their once-hidden presence more known, new, sinister mech designs have begun to appear on the battlefields of the Junctionworld inter-reality gate networks.

Notable among these new nightmares is a tailed, tentacled monstrosity labeled by intel operatives at the Mercenary Guild as Project Abby.

These warped, spiked, and twisted armors are malevolent in form and purpose. They have a heat cannon on one arm as their primary ranged weapon, while the melee component of their arsenal is composed of an energized whip weapon system. Crackling with plasma, this cluster of mechanical tentacles can be used to impale, crush, or slice through enemy targets. The Abby features a tail-like appendage that performs the same function, protecting the armored walker from the rear.

Project Abby mechs also seem to be nesting grounds for ScytheBots, verminous robot drones that seem to claim the dreaded hulks as mobile nests. These hive-like bots provide a symbiotic layer of protection for the mech, cutting down infantry that venture too close.

Some time ago I was felt very inspired by the 40K scale imperator titan from Zammerak you can find here in Cults, so I started remixing my own head variant, more close to the titan in the Titandeath cover, a design closer to the original Epic imperator model and featuring a full detailed interior cockpit. I used for the remix the head from the zammerak´s titan and a low poly faceplate model here in cults, apart from hundreds of bits from Cults and Thingiverse for the interior detailing.
The size is calibrated to lore 40K scale titan, of about 95-110 cms. It´s compatible with my Imperator model and Grant´s model but it will need to be rescalated about -25%
In the plans if fits OK but when I´ve printed it needed a lot of sanding in the cap part :-( Version 2 features a simplified cap with better fit.
The interior features complete cockpit with monitors, controls, a holographic display and a hiden room bellow with as little chapel and 2 servitors. Hope you like it :-) Complete crew (2 moderatii and 1 princeps) in the donators rewars folder.

This model is remixed from this models:

- For the base I used zammerak´s titan head, you can fin the complete titan in Cults free Here: https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/titanic-church-delivery-system
- For the faceplate I choose this model from Fantabuloustexan, Here free in Cults3D: https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/various/walkin-church-titan-head
- And hundreds of bits from Thingiverse and Cults3D

Updates/Changelog:

25-11-22 Added 3 neck versions for using in different imperator bodies sizes and a instructionsTXT
4-12-22 Added new head version 2! size adapted to my Imperator body (AT scale X 4), more detailed and with a simplified cap with better fit.

The Gorkabot is a massive armored mech, built as an effigy of a greenskin god! Armed to da teef da Gorkabot krushes all kind of ememys with it's klaw while shredding infantry with hails of bullets from the DAKKA-Storm gun.


In the Gorkabots belly is space for a few greenskins to pop out, if the time is good for some krumpin'!








FOR BEST QUALITY PRINT, PLEASE READ ALL(!) OF BELOW:





To print the Gorkabot, you need time or a resin printer ;-)


I REALLY recommend a layer high of 0.075 or lower for all parts to get the quality I intended.


Please see the pics, those are all printed in FDM (<=0,075mm)!





I tried to keep the need of tree supports low, but I highly recommend it to use them - make sure to set the tree support z-distance to a multiple of 2 (layer hight) for optimal removal (keep in mind: layer hight 0.05 to 0.075(!) )








----------------------------------------------------------------------


-------- EXCEPTIONAL 'fings for this model: ----------


----------------------------------------------------------------------








---------- COMPATIBILITY ----------





Arms and legs should be compatible to my Mega Bots (not testet)





---------- MAIN BODY ----------





"GorkaBot_Belly.stl" prints without tree support! Just use regular supports.


"GorkaBot_Torso.stl" prints without tree support! Just use regular supports. flip the model slightly to the back (see Cura screenshot)


The doors should be printed without supports with a brim (see Cura screenshot)





---------- LEGS ----------





The legs are unique, there is an individual model for the right / left leg. Those are mirrorable / interchangeable if you want.





---------- ARMS----------





The arms should fit 10x4mm magnets (not tested) but also have a ball joint for more posability...





The "GorkaBot_Klaw_Arm_02.stl" should be printed 45° "floating 1,5mm in the air" see my Cura screenshot - this will give you the best quality result!





---------- Over all printing recommendation! ----------





Many parts have a "flat surface" -> face those to the build plate.


Detaild sides / most visible sides should be faced towards the cooling fan.





---------- Assembly ----------





if you need instructions - just open all files in 3D Builder or e.g. Meshmixer. There you can look where they go








---------- FOLLOWING: ----------





Shame less beggin' for some coins for coffein I need doin' stuff like that :-D ;-)





Please consider a tip ....this highly detailed model was a work of 100h+ of free time!


If you do so, I HIGHLY APPRECIATE YOUR GENEROSITY :-) :-) :-)





Kind regards,


Tersus

A scaling and detail remodeling of the iconic Planet Express building (from Futurama), adapted for use within a generic SciFi setting, at 6mm scale.

I've added extra detail and scaled this specifically for 6mm scale FDM printing. I changed the building to add a side garage, rather than a glasshouse.

This set is intended to be compatible with the other 6mm SciFi terrain sets I have adapted and released. Please search my other things for more.

Please feel free to leave a tip if you like the model and think it is merited (and don't forget the original designers) - an occasional coffee helps fuel the creativity and effort and sustains morale :)

**Go to the "Thing Files" tab to individually download the files - Thingiverse is giving an odd 404 error when trying to use the "Download all files" buttons**

The perfect restaurant for watching S7 broadcasts or kicking back with the local mercs for a beer. This building is designed to be 3D printed as terrain for 6mm tabletop gaming. The top of the building is large and flat enough to support placing units on top in all hexes for playability. The top of version B has additional supports for two edge hexes for extra stability. It is 1 level tall in most areas, except for the front two hexes where it is 1.5 levels tall, if you're playing a specific mecha tabletop game.

There are eight files. For each of version A and B, one has the building on hexes, another is hexless so that you can print the one that fits your playstyle, and there are two more versions that have the text removed from the front of the building. Using the NoText versions, you can paint custom names on the front, print off logos to attach, or leave it blank.

As always, tipping is appreciated at: paypal.me/rainingfire416

Notable features:
-An in-universe themed restaurant name.
-Fantastic custom logo and details to give it a proper BBQ joint look.
-Detailed design including doors, windows, and a detailed roof with greebles.

The model units are in mm and it is scaled such that the hexes are 33mm from flat-to-flat, which is perfect for modern hex maps using 33mm hexes. You can always resize it if your hexes are slightly smaller/larger.

Please post pictures and leave feedback if you make this yourself! I'd love to see prints and use the feedback to adjust overhangs, detail levels, etc. on this model and future ones as well.

This is a shoulder/carapace mounted Turbolaser Destructor (twin turbolaser) for use with Stroganoff's Battleduke Warstrider model.

It's a mashup of this Apocalypse Rocket Launcher by totenpf:
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4814519
...the turbolaser barrels from this Wardog:
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/lucius-wardog-titan
...and part of the Laser Blaster model that comes with the Battleduke
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/epic-scale-mars-warlord-titan

It should fit exactly onto the Battleduke model if you print them both at the same scale. If you want to use it with an AT-scale model you'll need to scale it up a bit; probably about 125% but I don't know exactly as I haven't tried it and I don't currently have any AT models to measure.

The model is slightly asymmetrical. I think it works better on the right shoulder; mirror it for the left.
